articles.title: US Yields, Crude Oil prices cool | Tata Group Stocks In Focus on Tata Sons Tata Trusts Split
articles.description: Wall Street rallied on Thursday, with the Dow gaining 0.6%, the S&P 500 rising 1.1% and the Nasdaq surging 1.7%, as lower US Treasury yields and easing oil prices supported risk appetite. The US 10-year yield pulled back to 4.73%, while the 30-year and 2-year yields also declined. Brent crude eased to around $105 a barrel, with Saudi Arabia reportedly sending crude through ship-to-ship transfers. In India, the Nifty rose for the second straight day, while the Sensex ended slightly lower. Midcaps rebounded strongly, with the Midcap index gaining 1%. FIIs remained net sellers, offloading ₹3,208.76 crore in equities, while DIIs were net buyers with purchases worth ₹3,617.75 crore. Tata Group stocks are likely to remain in focus after Tata Sons reappointed N Chandrasekaran as Chairman. articles.title: NSE IPO Opens Today: Decoding Strengths, Concerns & Valuation | IPO Street
articles.description: Neha Dave, Special Analyst at MC Pro, joins Moneycontrol's IPO Street to break down everything investors need to know about the National Stock Exchange's much-awaited IPO, which opens for subscription today. Dave walks through the issue details — a ₹22,562-crore offer for sale with a price band of ₹1,700-1,785, valuing NSE at ₹4.42 lakh crore at the upper end. She discusses the exchange's key strengths, including its durable business model, high entry barriers, network effect moat, and position as a direct proxy to India's financialisation story. Dave also flags the key concerns, from heavy reliance on transaction income to regulatory tightening risks around equity options volumes. She rounds off with MC Pro's valuation take and shares whether long-term investors should consider subscribing to the issue.
